name: 2D Laser SLAM Occupancy Grid Benchmark Framework
description: A framework for assessing the quality of occupancy grid maps produced by 2D laser-based SLAM algorithms using novel metrics and tests.
evaluation_method: composite_score (map similarity metrics such as IoU / F1 / RMSE aggregated)
reputation: A niche but respected research benchmark used in SLAM and robotics mapping work for evaluating occupancy-grid map quality.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on 2D laser-based SLAM; evaluation depends on multiple complementary metrics (no single universally accepted score); risk of overfitting to sensor/noise models and simulator-specific artifacts; not saturated.
